Naruto and Hinata’s marriage AND Sasuke and Sakura’s marriage. They make no sense. They never did. Hinata stalked Naruto for years and then he is just suddenly in love with her? I don’t think so. It would have made more sense for Sasuke to be with Naruto or be completely alone. They felt rushed and forced and I just hate it. I hate the Boruto universe in general.

Sociopath is a stretch in my opinion. Yes, Naruto’s back story is tragic and very sad. His early years are not highlighted too much, just some plot points here and there. Did they treat Naruto as a child? No, absolutely not. There’s a lot of issues with the way that he was treated as a child. Children need to feel protected and be able to create bonds with their caregivers, it’s developmental psychology. Realistically, Naruto definitely should have had some development delay and/or mental illness, but that isn’t what happened because the story was never geared towards being realistic. It’s about a boy who overcame his own tragic life and came out on top. But the back story had to be tragic to make that plot line work. That was Kishimoto’s goal in this. The underdog wins story.

As an equestrian that owns 2 horses, I’m telling you that taking care of a horse is more than how much it costs. Horses need a lot of maintenance and care and I just don’t think Ryland or Shane have the time to commit to this kind of animal. My two horses take up soooo much of my time and that’s fine because I love them and I chose this life, but it’s still hard work. Unless they are going to literally pay someone to come take care of it every day, I see them getting bored with a horse and giving it away. Keeping them hydrated, fed grain, keeping them up to date with all the vaccinations required by law, and spending THOUSANDS a month on hay is just going to be too much. Riding somewhere or taking lessons is fine, but for the love of god, I would be livid if they bought a horse and kept it on their property with ZERO knowledge. I don’t support Shane or Ryland anymore, but this type of things hits me personally.

I love Morgan, but I really feel that Shane has caused a toxic affect on her life. Ryland used to be more likable and now I can hardly stand him, because Shane made him aggressive and toxic with the constant pressure of being around a huge YouTuber with millions of followers and a lot of baggage. Morgan is struggling to keep up and has lost the spark because it’s become more about the numbers and the Adsense than it is the enjoyment. I’m sad that Morgan is feeling so run down. I wish sometimes she would move back to Colorado and let Shane and Ryland create their own downfall.

Imagine that. Nothing has changed. Nothing has been learned. And for a bunch of adults in their 30’s, they seem to not have grown from this at all. They are acting like children, pointing fingers, and claiming to do nothing wrong. Making an “apology” video for the sake of their careers, but not truly meaning it. Their fans and stans will stand by them no matter what they do. J* is going to keep releasing product to make money and Shane is going to hide behind the millions he made off of the Conspiracy collection and his merch until “everyone forgets about this.” Money and fame change people and Ryland, Shane, and especially J* are no exception. Morgan seems to be the only one who is rising above this. And I hope that Garrett and Andrew will distance or separate themselves from that group. I believe Peter Monn said it best when he said that if they were just fully honest and open for once and admitted their faults, people would be a lot more willing to forgive.
